test one's patience: Waiting in line for three hours at the post office really tested my patience.
在郵局排隊等了三個小時，真的考驗我的耐心。
test the waters: Before opening a real shop, Mia decided to test the waters by selling her cakes online first.
在開實體店之前，米亞決定先在網路上賣蛋糕來試水溫。
test positive: If you test positive for the flu, you should stay home and rest instead of going to school.
如果你流感檢測陽性，你應該待在家休息，而不是去上學。
test a theory: The students designed a simple experiment to test a theory about how light affects plant growth.
學生們設計了一個簡單的實驗，來驗證關於光線如何影響植物生長的理論。
put to the test: Our teamwork was put to the test when the power went out in the middle of the school play.
學校話劇演到一半時停電，我們的團隊合作因此接受了考驗。
test one's limits: Running a full marathon in the summer heat will really test your limits, so train carefully.
在夏天的高溫下跑全程馬拉松會真正挑戰你的極限，所以要謹慎訓練。
testify in court: The woman who saw the accident agreed to testify in court about what she had seen that night.
目擊車禍的那位女士同意出庭作證，說出她那晚看到的情況。
testify against someone: Although he was afraid, the young man decided to testify against his former boss for stealing money.
雖然很害怕，那位年輕人仍決定作證指控他的前老闆偷錢。
testify to one's ability: The many prizes she has won testify to her ability as a talented young pianist.
她贏得的許多獎項證明了她身為一位有才華的年輕鋼琴家的能力。
testify to the fact: The long lines outside the new restaurant testify to the fact that its food is very popular.
那家新餐廳外大排長龍，證實了它的食物非常受歡迎這個事實。
thread one's way through: The delivery driver threaded his way through the crowded night market to bring us our food.
外送員在擁擠的夜市中穿行而過，把食物送來給我們。
thread a needle: My grandmother's eyes are not good anymore, so she always asks me to thread a needle for her.
我奶奶的視力已經不好了，所以她總是請我幫她穿針。
lose the thread: The speaker talked so fast and changed topics so often that many listeners began to lose the thread.
講者說得太快又常常換話題，許多聽眾開始失去頭緒。
hang by a thread: After the terrible car accident, the driver's life seemed to hang by a thread for several days.
那場嚴重車禍後，駕駛的性命似乎有好幾天都命懸一線。
a common thread: Although the three stories are set in different countries, a common thread of family love runs through them all.
雖然這三個故事發生在不同的國家，但它們都貫穿著家庭之愛這個共同脈絡。
thread beads: At the summer camp, the children learned to thread beads onto strings to make colorful bracelets.
在夏令營裡，孩子們學會把珠子串在線上，做成色彩繽紛的手環。
threaten to resign: The coach threatened to resign if the school refused to give the team more time to practice.
教練威脅說，如果學校拒絕給球隊更多練習時間，他就要辭職。
threaten lives: Driving after drinking can threaten lives, not only the driver's but also those of people on the street.
酒後駕車會危及生命，不只是駕駛自己的，也包括街上行人的生命。
threaten the environment: Plastic bags that are thrown into the sea threaten the environment and harm many sea animals.
被丟進海裡的塑膠袋威脅環境，並傷害許多海洋動物。
rain threatens: Dark clouds are gathering over the mountains and rain threatens, so let's move the party indoors.
烏雲正在山上聚集，看來要下雨了，所以我們把派對移到室內吧。
threaten with violence: The robber threatened the shop owner with violence and demanded all the money in the cash register.
搶匪以暴力威脅店主，並要求收銀機裡所有的錢。
a threatened species: The black-faced spoonbill is a threatened species, so people in Tainan work hard to protect its home.
黑面琵鷺是受威脅物種，所以臺南的人們努力保護牠的棲息地。
be thrilled to hear: My parents were thrilled to hear that I had been accepted by the university I wanted most.
我爸媽聽到我被最想去的大學錄取時很興奮。
thrill the audience: The young magician's amazing tricks were able to thrill the audience from the beginning to the end of the show.
那位年輕魔術師的驚人把戲從表演開始到結束都讓觀眾興奮不已。
thrill-seeking: My thrill-seeking brother loves bungee jumping and riding the scariest roller coasters in the amusement park.
我那尋求刺激的哥哥喜歡高空彈跳，也喜歡搭遊樂園裡最可怕的雲霄飛車。
thrilled to bits: When Grandma opened the present and saw the photo album we made, she was thrilled to bits.
奶奶打開禮物看到我們做的相簿時，她高興極了。
business thrives: Since the new train station opened nearby, the little noodle shop's business thrives every day.
自從附近的新火車站啟用後，那家小麵店的生意天天興旺。
thrive on pressure: Some students thrive on pressure and actually do their best work the night before a deadline.
有些學生在壓力下茁壯，其實在截止日前一晚表現得最好。
thrive on challenges: Our team leader seems to thrive on challenges; the harder the problem, the more excited she becomes.
我們的組長似乎越挫越勇；問題越困難，她就越興奮。
children thrive: Experts say that children thrive when they get enough sleep, healthy food, and plenty of love at home.
專家說，孩子在家中得到充足的睡眠、健康的食物和許多的愛時，就會茁壯成長。
a thriving industry: Thanks to the growing interest in mobile games, game design has become a thriving industry in Taiwan.
由於人們對手機遊戲的興趣日益增加，遊戲設計在臺灣已成為一個蓬勃的產業。
thrive in a new job: Although Ben was nervous at first, he managed to thrive in a new job by asking questions and learning quickly.
雖然班一開始很緊張，但他藉由發問和快速學習，在新工作上發展順利。
